# IMDb Mobile

> > The mobile version of the Internet Movie Database, featuring comprehensive rankings, charts, and curated lists of films and television shows.

IMDb Mobile provides access to the world's most popular source for movie, TV, and celebrity content. The site features authoritative rankings like the Top 250 TV shows, user-curated collections spanning genres from period dramas to horror, and comprehensive information on acclaimed series including Breaking Bad, Game of Thrones, Planet Earth, and Band of Brothers.

## Key Topics

- Top 250 TV Shows
- IMDb Charts and Rankings
- User Ratings
- Breaking Bad
- Planet Earth
- Band of Brothers
- Chernobyl
- Game of Thrones
- Period Dramas
- Horror Films
- True Crime Documentaries
- Curated Movie Lists
- TV Series Rankings
- Documentary Series
- User-Generated Collections

## Top Charts and Rankings

- [Top 250 TV shows](https://m.imdb.com/chart/toptv/?ref_=watch_fanfav_nv_menu): IMDb's Top 250 TV shows ranked by user ratings

## Optional: User-Curated Collections

- [Period Dramas-The Victorian Era 1837-1901](https://m.imdb.com/list/ls000066901/): User-curated list of Victorian Era period dramas and mini series
- [Overlooked/Underrated Horror Films](https://m.imdb.com/list/ls032853033/): User-curated collection of underrated horror films
- [Killer Animal/Insects and Giants Monsters (Horror) Movies](https://m.imdb.com/list/ls050510252/): User list of creature feature and monster horror movies
- [The Harry Potter Saga: 2001 - 2011](https://m.imdb.com/list/ls000630791/): Complete Harry Potter film series collection list
- [True Crime TV Series, Docuseries & Documentaries](https://m.imdb.com/list/ls028157820/): User-curated list of true crime shows and documentaries
